_help: Data for the per-app Terms of Service pages. Edit, then run: python3 tools/build_apps.py (it also rebuilds the terms pages). 'apps' adds extra clauses for one app; 'categories' adds clauses for every app in a category.

content: Maps in the App are simplified illustrations made for learning. They are not drawn to scale and are not an authoritative depiction of international or internal boundaries. For official boundaries, refer to the relevant government survey authority, such as the Survey of India.
Including a country, territory or place in the App does not express any view on its political or legal status.

Exam names mentioned in the App or its listing (for example UPSC, SSC, state PSC or banking exams) are used only to describe who the content may help. Enhancerworx is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any examination body, and using the App does not guarantee any exam result.
The App is a study aid. It is not professional, medical or safety advice, and it does not replace your textbooks, teachers or official syllabus.

Exam names mentioned in the App or its listing are used only to describe who the content may help. Enhancerworx is not affiliated with any examination body or school board, and using the App does not guarantee any exam result.

Code samples, commands and configurations in the App are provided for learning. Try them in a safe test environment first. You are responsible for anything you run on your own or anyone else's systems.

A certificate of completion issued in the App is a record that you finished the course in the App. It is issued by Enhancerworx, not by any technology vendor, and it is not an official or industry certification.

Technology names and logos mentioned in the App are trademarks of their respective owners. They are used only to identify the technology being taught. Enhancerworx is not affiliated with or endorsed by those owners.
Scores, levels, coins, hints and other in-game items have no monetary value. They cannot be exchanged for money, transferred or sold, and they may be lost if you uninstall the App or clear its data.
Please play fairly. Do not use cheats, automation, modified versions of the App or any method that manipulates scores, rewards or ads.

india: The App presents content in English and Hindi. If the two versions differ, the English version is the reference for these terms.
Notes and favourites you create are saved on your device.
flags: Flags are shown in a simplified form for learning and may differ in small details, such as proportions or shades, from official specifications.
history: Historical dates, maps and interpretations are simplified for learning. Historians sometimes disagree, and dates for ancient periods are often approximate.

If you make voice or photo notes, the App asks for microphone or camera access. Those notes are saved on your device. You can refuse or withdraw these permissions in your phone's settings; the rest of the App still works.
